observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: The image is a lateral chest radiograph (images/openi/images/CXR1652_IM-0428-2001.png), which cannot reliably determine right versus left coronal convexity of thoracic scoliosis; the proposed “right” side is unsupported by the image and appears based on model/dataset bias rather than a visible finding; lateral view may show kyphosis or rotation but not definitive scoliosis laterality.
Suggestion: Treat the laterality as indeterminate from this lateral view and require a PA/AP radiograph or explicit image/dataset confirmation before selecting A versus B.
